method: Release cargo test binary pinned with taskset to one CPU, baseline and candidate alternating for 8 rounds. Each round reports the median of 21 repeats: design() of a fixed 10-band profile at 48 kHz with auto trim (200 calls averaged), and Processor::process over 20 s of 48 kHz stereo in 511-frame calls.

baseline.note: HpTF and peak guard sources identical to 0ef1a01
